title: Courage and Boldness
definition: Courage and Boldness is Spirit-empowered faithfulness to speak, obey, endure, and stand for Christ without fear of people.
summary: Courage and Boldness is Spirit-enabled faithfulness to speak and obey despite fear, pressure, opposition, or cost.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reigns with all authority and gives His witnesses courage to confess Him before the world.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Courage and boldness are Spirit-enabled faithfulness when obedience to Christ is costly or frightening. Scripture shows believers speaking and living for Christ despite opposition, weakness, and fear.

Biblical boldness is not harshness, arrogance, or love of conflict. It is humble confidence in God that refuses to deny the truth or abandon obedience.

Jesus stood faithful before enemies, rulers, and the cross. Believers draw courage from His victory and presence.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because fear often silences witness, weakens obedience, and traps believers in people-pleasing. Courage and boldness help disciples remain faithful without becoming combative or proud.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Name the fear that most often mutes your obedience. Pray for Spirit-given boldness, speak truth with love, and take one faithful step even if your voice trembles.
